_comment: Item id -> item model to draw instead. Recipe *ingredients* match by item id
and cannot carry components, so an ingredient that is really a disguised RA
item has to be listed here or the picture shows the base item. Results need
no entry: their minecraft:item_model component is read straight off the
recipe. Keep this in step with the give functions.
minecraft:command_block is deliberately absent — the Item Crate keeps that
one and is never a recipe ingredient.
